method: Read the three selected source files and publisher READMEs through GitHub's connected file API at previously recorded immutable commit IDs. No checkout, execution, input data, VM, Windows, or Defender change.

products.name: Backstage Parser
products.dependencies: Python 3 standard library only: os, re, sys, json, codecs, argparse, datetime.
products.behavior: Reads user-selected Office Backstage cache files or directories; writes user-selected JSON/TSV/CSV/PSV output and a log.
products.packageBoundary: Stage source and notices only. Do not enumerate Office profiles or run the parser as part of RIDE installation.

products.name: CyberGate Log Decrypt
products.dependencies: Python standard library only: sys, re, codecs.
products.behavior: Reads a user-selected keylogger ciphertext file and writes decrypted plaintext to a sibling filename ending _decrypted.
products.packageBoundary: Stage source and notices only. The encrypted/decrypted data is user-controlled input/output and is never accessed by RIDE.

products.name: Gmail URL Decoder
products.dependencies: Python standard library only: re, mmap, argparse, json, collections, base64, datetime.
products.behavior: Reads a user-selected plaintext or raw-data input file and writes JSON to a user-selected output file.
products.packageBoundary: Stage source and notices only. RIDE does not inspect user files or run the decoder.
